label: Software Engineer
leadText: I build modern, high-performance web applications across the full stack, specializing in frontend development and framworks while remaining comfortable on the backend. bodyText: I approach problems with curiosity and a bias toward action, blending technical precision with creative thinking. label: Contact
leadText: The sum is greater than its parts. People are many things; not just a job title.
bodyText: If you look at an engine and just call it "rotator", you miss the combustion, the timing, and the chaos that actually makes it work. People are the same. We have a habit of using a single label to describe a complex person. We pick one prase "Software Engineer" and ignore the rest of the machine. But humans aren't built to be reduced to a single noun. You are a son, a daughter, a friend, a creator, a mess, a masterpiece.
